profile.headline: VP, Lead Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase & Co.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Alternative Investments
positions.description:
• Creating web qualification applications for Alternative Investments of High-Net Worth Accounts using Java - Spring Framework and Angular
• Improved application load time by 90% by introducing virtual scroll, lazy loading, and indexing functionality
• Standardized testing practices for Angular apps. across in PB sector by creating unit testing baselines

positions.title: Associate Application Analyst and Developer
positions.description:
• Developed first-ever Alert notification system using Angular and Java for Summit to improve client-based efficiency
• Created Claims Search application using old databases, AngularJS, and Java to enable agents to view/print claims records online
• Imported entire 3000+ articles and reports internal database from MediaWiki to Confluence by creating an automatic real-time conversion program using Python and Confluence Server REST API.

projects.title: iBalance
projects.description:
• iPhone app to assess upper extremity proprioception and stability using accelerometer and gyroscope
• Built an algorithm that calculates path length using sensor data and graphs using a Python script
• Research accepted to IOC World Conference – Prevention of Injury & Illness in Sport

projects.title: Buck-To-Go
projects.description:
• Developed a native mobile app using Ionic and Google Firebase as back-end system
• Reduced waiting time for students in ordering food and increased efficiency of pizza shop
• Designed as well as created a multi-order queue web application using Angular to reduce waiting time

publications.title: There's An App For That: Reliability Of An Iphone App To Assess Upper Extremity Proprioception And Stability
publications.publisher: British Journal of Sports Medicine · Feb 1, 2017
